title: Filmiõhtu 16: Valgusmuusika filmid / Film Evening 16: Light-Music Films
license: no licence notice; ETV/ERR archive, all rights reserved implied
notes: Estonian with a Russian seam: ETV's light-music film evening. Bulat Galeyev of the Prometheus colour-music laboratory in Kazan talking (Russian, burnt-in Estonian subtitles and a period name super), then excerpts of four abstract light-films — Väike triptühhon (Sviridov, dir. Galeyev, Prometheus, Kazan 1975: dark flame forms), the LONG window from Perpetuum mobile (music Arvo Pärt, dir. Jüri Tallinn, laser by Tõnis Mägi, ETV 1979: a luminous ring and bursts of white on black), Klaasikillumäng (Erkki-Sven Tüür, Tallinnfilm 1985: cracked glass) and Hingus (Sven Grünberg, Riga 1987: white sparks scattering on black) — closing on a 1989 computer-video showreel.
